themes.consensus_view: Most banks think the Fed will keep rates on hold and that traders betting on more rate hikes overdid it, especially after June's weak jobs report, but a vocal minority argues the opposite: hikes are underpriced and could go further than markets expect.

US money markets pared back their pricing of Fed rate hikes somewhat.
